label: exact64

registered_congruent_reference.method: Rigid registration of the original congruent donor reference. Both frozen target vertices and triangle centers are checked against the registered reference and vice versa. No design dimension is intentionally changed. Exact donor print meshes are retained to avoid Boolean triangulation artifacts.

baseline_body_policy: Frozen F3 print mesh is authoritative. Recorded bed and owner transforms register it against the unchanged assembly hardware. Differences from regenerated assembly body are reported, not attributed to this change.
proof_scope: New body is a subset of the validated computational reference in the same rigid coordinate frame. A registered_congruent_reference, when present, uses an independently measured congruent source boundary within 0.0001 mm to avoid a second numerically unstable Boolean regeneration; its frozen source and printed reference hashes are verified. Where nominal_reference_recovery is present, the reference is the unchanged analytic O22 CAD with separately measured sub-0.0001 mm boundary agreement to the frozen print mesh. This proves no new geometric interference under any rigid pose. It does not prove stress/fatigue equivalence or the retention of every contact; actual assembly contacts and axis-limit samples are separately listed.

qualified_small_nut_corner_reliefs.scope: Within a 0.08 mm clearance band outside every nut planar face with original surrounding material, retain at least 98% of material and preserve the face core 0.15 mm from its edges. This protects nominal flat spacing and bearing centers, without claiming a load test.

qualified_magnet_retention_entry_reliefs.criteria: Magnet-cap M2 nuts only, independently identified by matching magnet_screw hardware. Entire screw-facing bearing footprint and existing material through 1 mm remain unchanged. Opposite unloaded entry-face band retains >=95% and its 0.15 mm inset core, with >=70% of existing 1 mm backing. Anti-rotation flats retain >=99% through 0.5 mm and their 0.25 mm inset cores. Screw and nut geometry/position are unchanged. This is geometry screening, not a strength/creep test.
qualified_magnet_retention_entry_reliefs.source_design_evidence: cad/revO15/twist.py: sensor-cap M2x4 screws and magnet_nut pockets; radial M3 brake and captured rotor collar are separate.

pose_qualification_scope: Subtraction proves no new interference at any rigid pose. Base assembly contacts and sampled initially nonintersecting contacts are protected. Samples already intersecting in the unchanged assembly are reported separately; they are not certified as achievable poses.
